{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

dup_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Duplicate patient_ids: {dup_count} patients have multiple rows')

# Check sample_seq distribution for duplicates
if dup_count > 0:
    dup_rows = data[data['patient_id'].isin(duplicate_patients.index)]
    max_seq_per_patient = dup_rows.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
    print(f'Max sample_seq per duplicated patient:
{max_seq_per_patient}
')
    
    # Confirm that sample_seq is increasing with re-testing
    seq_check = dup_rows.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].apply(lambda x: list(x) == sorted(x, reverse=True))
    print(f'Sample_seq monotonic (decreasing) per patient: {seq_check.all()}')"}
